# APT Versions

This page is for **operators** who run the `plugin-apt-versions` plugin with the CCF Agent, and for **developers** who write policies for it. It documents [v0.7.0](https://github.com/compliance-framework/plugin-apt-versions/releases/tag/v0.7.0) and is generated from the plugin's [README at v0.7.0](https://github.com/compliance-framework/plugin-apt-versions/blob/v0.7.0/README.md).

## How it works

### Usage

You can use this plugin by passing it to the compliiance agent

```shell
agent --plugin=[PATH_TO_YOUR_BINARY]
```

## Requirements

### Prerequisites

* GoReleaser https://goreleaser.com/install/
